dataset.revision_resolution: Resolve and save immutable commit before download/selection; recorded in source manifest
dataset.scan_order: published train_sft shard order then row order
dataset.content: first user message only; discard supplied assistant answers and all later turns
dataset.eligible: nonempty first-user prompt; exact pinned current Qwen nonthinking chat template length20..160 inclusive; no truncation
dataset.deduplication: normalized whitespace prompt text; source/schema identifiers also validated
dataset.scope: Declared bounded length-filtered source distribution, not representative of all chat tasks

generation.hard_time_limit: Deadline stopping criterion; unfinished deadline trace preserved but excluded, stop entire preparation; no automatic continuation
generation.completion: 128 distinct valid traces or stop; no regeneration for length or quality

consumption.mask: original prompt and continuation active; padding zero; identical both arms

nested_selection.input: 128 frozen consumed records and masks only
nested_selection.tie_break: lexicographically smallest source prompt_id tuple in bin order
nested_selection.algorithm: exact deterministic dynamic programming; freeze/hash implementation before generation
nested_selection.training_order: 128 in fixed accepted source-shuffle order;16 in that same parent order; trainer seeded shuffle unchanged

training.snapshot: last actual soft forward pre-update parameters and sharpness
training.retained: embeddings, head, vision, small recurrent gates, convolutions, norms and dynamics; MLP gate_proj stays quantized

preflight.failure_action: preserve evidence and stop; no changed coverage or hyperparameters

evaluation.scope: repeated development diagnostics; no final-confirmation claim

stop_after: completed and sealed paired evaluations, or any failed data/safety/correctness gate
